current_app_protection: Tests protect pmp-app-current.html and its current route chain.
conflict_policy: If tests fail, cleanup/remodel promotion is blocked.
smoke_test: S3 Confirm current inner app loads.
S4 Confirm Bug Memory route opens.
S6 Confirm no obvious old-version bounce.
deep_test: D9 Copy Lossless Report direct-tap behavior.
D15 User-facing app still says PMP Current.
pass_rule: Smoke test is enough for writing control files. Deep test is required before any archive/delete promotion or touched-tool cleanup.
